W12.title: Refund mechanics: Idempotency-Key retries through provider faults, pending until the webhook, events out of order

steps.name: a buyer with six tickets for an event ten days away

a refund stays refund_pending (no email, not counted) until its refund.created event, delivered out of order
refund.created delivered again changes nothing and sends nothing; every refund used its own key
